title: Benefit Accounting Desk Entry — Year-End Expiry of RideLink Value-Added Trips
content:
Value-added trips of Non-Emergency Medical Transportation are loaded for a benefit year, the calendar year, and do not run on indefinitely. At the close of a year the desk posts the year's expiry entry on the member's value-added trip ledger.

## Rule

The year-end expiry entry is booked once for the benefit year before the current one, which is the previous benefit year, and records that year and the trips that expire. At the close of a benefit year, the trips of that year that expire do so on December 31, and all unused trips expire when the benefit closes.

**Effect.** The expiry entry for the previous benefit year's unused trips stands on the value-added trip ledger, and the trips it carries are gone from the member's value-added trips for good. The member sees the expiry, its year and its trip count in their value-added trip history.

*Hypothetical timing:* in any month of 2027, the previous benefit year is 2026, and its expiry entry records 2026 as its benefit year.

## The posting tool

The entry is posted with `expire_year_trips_0d38b23b`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`. One call adds one expiry entry, dated today; nothing else on the benefit changes.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ride_benefit_id` | Reference number of the member's transportation benefit, as the transportation benefit lookup returns it for the verified member | Identifier |
| `benefit_year` | The benefit year whose trips expire | YYYY, a four-digit calendar year with no month or day |
| `trips` | The number of trips that expire | Whole number of one-way trips, positive, no decimals |

**Return.** A text dictionary: `status` is the literal "expired" when the entry was posted, which is the success receipt; `ledger_entry` is the reference of the new expiry entry; `benefit_year` echoes the year as YYYY; `trips` is the integer number of trips expired; `posted_date` is today's date as YYYY-MM-DD.
